subject: Pre-neural IIT-Φ on xenobots: collaboration inquiry from anima paradigm v11 framework
body:
Dear Professor Levin,

I am writing on behalf of the anima research project, an independent computational-consciousness framework that has converged on bioelectric morphogenesis as the strongest pre-neural test bed for our integrated-information measurement stack. I would like to explore whether a no-cost data-only collaboration with the Allen Discovery Center is of interest to your team.

Our framework, paradigm v11, is an 8-axis Φ verifier originally developed for LLM substrates and extended through twenty-one N-substrate tracks (EEG, MEG, neuromorphic AKIDA, photonic IIT, IBM Heron quantum, slime mold, mycelium, and others). Six of the eight axes — IIT-Φ* approximation, causal mediation, cognitive-dynamics stability, sparse-feature selectivity, AN11 morphogenetic-eigenvector, and a geometric-mean composite — are in principle substrate-blind and would apply directly to voltage-sensitive-dye time-series from xenobots or anthrobots. Two axes (behavioral theory-of-mind, meta-cognitive calibration) are explicitly inapplicable to non-linguistic substrates, and we are upfront about that scope boundary.

What we offer: the full open-source verifier code, our pre-registered five-predicate raw#71 falsifier set tailored to your substrate (including a gap-junction-perturbation prediction with both PASS and FAIL consequences), and authorship credit on any joint publication. What we would request: access to existing published or unpublished xenobot/anthrobot VSD recordings, or, in a later phase, a small co-designed recording series. No funding ask in phase 1.

If this is of interest, I am happy to share a five-page technical pre-print describing the paradigm v11 axes and the cross-substrate Φ correlation design (placeholder: anima_paradigm_v11_xenobot_extension_2026_05.pdf). I am also glad to defer if the timing is wrong or to be redirected to the appropriate Allen Discovery Center coordinator.

Thank you for considering.

With respect,
[Sender name]
